name: Foundation of the Koplin Compact
description: Koplin, Solace and Meridian sign the initial compact standardising transit law and commercial arbitration.

name: Solace Driveworks Opens
description: Helix opens its first major propulsion complex on Solace II.

name: Varda Biosphere Research Charter
description: The Varda Biosphere Enclave receives a permanent research charter focused on closed-habitat biology.

name: Meridian Freeport Act
description: Meridian gains its modern freeport status and independent exchange authority.

name: Orison Synthetic Recognition
description: Orison recognises persistent synthetic minds as legal persons with civic standing.

name: Dart Courier Class Certified
description: Asterion's Dart Courier receives Reach-wide commercial certification.

name: Damaris Corridor Rescue Crisis
description: A cascading navigation failure strands dozens of vessels and drives major investment in frontier rescue infrastructure.

name: Crown Habitat Expansion Milestone
description: A new expansion arc opens, accelerating Haven's transformation into one of the Reach's largest orbital population centres.

name: Velari Trade Access Accords
description: The Compact adopts mutual recognition rules simplifying residence, employment and commercial contracts for Velari citizens.

name: Civic Continuity Accord Launched
description: The first cross-system framework for persistent synthetic legal identity enters implementation.
